bear_assumptions: EUR 30 forward EPS at 30x, converted at the current USD/EUR rate; export limits, customer delays, capacity costs and working-capital drag compress growth and the franchise premium.
base_assumptions: EUR 38 forward EPS at 38x, converted at the current USD/EUR rate; raised guidance converts, installed-base sales grow and margins remain strong, with no Terafab economics included.
bull_assumptions: EUR 46 forward EPS at 45x, converted at the current USD/EUR rate; leading-edge Logic and Memory demand, capacity expansion and High-NA adoption outperform without material export or cash-conversion deterioration.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower market price or stronger primary operating evidence clears the canonical expected-return, base-return, payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade the thesis if EUV or High-NA adoption, customer roadmaps, export access, margins, cash conversion, balance-sheet strength or capital allocation materially deteriorates.
